summary: I found what caused the inn.night hang and fixed it. With the fix, smoke plus all 16 inn suites (6 of them new) pass in one run, twice in a row: runs innI6 and innI7, 17 suites, 227 checks, 0 failures, newErrors=0. The stall was not Inn logic. The test profile copies Julius' prefs, which autosave once per game day. In 1.7 the autosave only starts after its Autosaving screen has been drawn once. A game window that is hidden (behind the other slots, on another desktop space, minimized) draws nothing, so the save never starts. The game then sits idle (main thread waiting in kevent) until the window becomes visible or the 900 s timeout kills it. inn.night is the first suite whose waits cross the one-day mark, so it was always the one that stopped; venues stalled the same way in the m1 matrix. Proof: run innI3 stalled the same way. When I brought the stalled window to the front, the autosave file was written at that moment and the suite carried on. Run innI4 still stalled after I switched off only forced normal speed, so that was not the cause. Run innI5, with autosave off, passed inn.night in about 1.5 minutes. My first guess, that combat forced the game to 1x speed, was wrong; I kept that switch anyway because combat does slow test runs. On top of the fix: one vanilla-visitor fallback, the GuestApi renown/whispers API and the other module hooks, door policy with the one-liners, the wing status line, the waiting/night bell thoughts, return visits, the leaving gift, and the day-visitor path, each with a test. The branch is int/inn in /Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HH_wt/i_inn, 5 commits on c5c9000. The 1.7 build is clean and the 410 unit tests pass.
implemented: Hang fix: InnTestKit.FastTime() runs at the start of every inn suite. It sets Prefs.AutosaveIntervalDays = 1000 for the throwaway test profile and DebugViewSettings.neverForceNormalSpeed = true. The diagnosis is written up in docs/inn.md.

Single fallback: GuestFallback moved out of VenueShopping.cs into Source/Hearth/Venues/GuestFallback.cs. It is ticked by its own always-on GuestFallbackModule (ModuleId.Core, no save data), so it works with the Inn on or off. GuestFallback.Drives(p) is false for every Inn-registered guest, Run(map) runs at most once per tick even with the old Venues caller, and a Driven set lets tests check who was driven. Inn guests keep their own think tree (JobGiver_HH_GuestActivity).

GuestApi, source compatible: GuestInfo.Vip (Wealth >= VipWealth, which is 60); GuestApi.Renown(map), RenownStars, Whispers(map), AddRenown(map, delta, reason), HasRenown and NeutralRenown (50 without the Inn). The Inn supplies these through a new optional interface IGuestRenownImpl on GuestApiBridge. Also a new GuestApi.SatisfactionChanged event.

Whispers: while the Underworld module runs, it owns them; the Inn sends its own increases (guest killed +4, arrested +5) there through GuestRegistry.AddWhispers. Without Underworld the Inn keeps its own count.

Underworld hooks: the Inn subscribes to Underworld.RenownDelta and applies it through ChangeRenown(delta, reason). Shady stays get GuestRecord.Shady, can be forced with GuestArrivalRequest.ForceShady or are rolled for rough/outlaw factions once the underworld is unlocked, and call Underworld.MarkShady. While the underworld is visible, faction pick weights use RespectableArrivalFactor and OutlawArrivalFactor.

Hospitality import: the HospitalityImport.GuestBedImported event switches CompHH_GuestBed on and calls MarkAdopted; pending beds are adopted again on game load. Area_HH_GuestWing got the (AreaManager) constructor next to (AreaManager, string). The importer puts wings into the vanilla area list; MapComponent_HH_GuestWings now moves them into its own list within 250 ticks.
UI shell: sets HearthUI.GuestBedProbe, sets HearthUI.RenownLine when nobody else has, and adds an overview section inn.wings.
GuestInfo.PlannedLeaveTick changes made by other modules (DLC shrines) are honoured both ways; tested.

Door policy (5.9, N28/N29): new DoorPolicy class saved in the register, and a Dialog_HH_DoorPolicy window opened from a front desk gizmo and an overview button. Factions and tech level filter at planning. Stay kinds filter at planning and arrival. Gender and age go straight into the PawnGenerationRequest. Xenotype and royal title use a validator (8 tries, then the slot stays empty). The wealth band re-rolls, then clamps into the band. Returning guests are checked first. When the window closes it shows a one-liner aimed at the player: 'Ugh. A hippie.' for allow-all, 'Woke, but with limits, huh?' for the default, and one line per restricting filter, plus a welcome-share preview.

Wing status line (N31): WingStatus builds 'Guest Wing 1: Bedroom ✓ · Kitchen ✓/✗ reason · Restaurant ✗ missing · est. ★★★', with Bathroom added only when Dubs Bad Hygiene is active. It is shown on guest beds, the front desk, the overview page and the HearthUI section, cached for 250 ticks.

5.13: new settings inn.deskOpenHour and inn.deskCloseHour (6-22). Outside those hours, with no host at the desk, check-in works as an honesty box with inn.honestyDiscount (-10%, rounded to whole silver). New thoughts HH_GuestWaited, HH_GuestBellNobody and HH_GuestWaitingRoom come from GuestThoughts.Waited and from a bridge on the Venues module's 'nobody came' outcomes. A waiting room (seats or a lounge venue) lowers the waiting thought one stage and adds +1 to +4 by impressiveness. Day visitors leave at last orders: when no venue is open now and in 30 minutes.

5.14: return visits, days = 2 x travel + Lerp(10,3) or Lerp(14,30) by satisfaction. They go into the forecast as PlannedGroup.Returning, and the pawns are kept as forcefully-kept world pawns until they arrive or the plan is dropped. Gift on leaving with chance Lerp(0.2,0.9,V): a small item at the front desk. New settings inn.returnVisits and inn.leavingGifts.

New suites: inn.fallback (vanilla VisitorGroup plus a shop venue with the Inn on, then with the Inn off), inn.door, inn.wingstatus, inn.contracts, inn.dayvisit (venue opening hours, Inn brain, leaving at closing), inn.returns. inn.handling's insult check was flaky and is now deterministic through GuestRegistry.InsultChanceOverride.
Keyed/HH_Inn.xml regenerated (243 keys). tools/inn/gen_keyed.py now leaves out HH.Venue.* keys so they are not duplicated. New docs file docs/inn.md.
not_done: Night bell at the front desk itself: the bell and waiting for staffed services belong to Venues (6.1). The Inn adds only the thoughts and the honesty box at the desk.

Door policy: there is no 'Turn away at the door', no ideoligion/memes, traits or archetype categories, no 'Handled by ...' line for ModSettingsOverrides, and no goodwill or diversity-meme consequences from Overbooked on. 'Allow all' and the default behave the same in vanilla because hostile factions never visit either way; only the one-liner differs.

Wing status: the kitchen and restaurant checks use a 30-cell straight distance instead of a real door-path length of 30, and do not look at no-guest zones. The star estimate is the best guest room's score.
Return visits: travel time is estimated from settlement distance. A return can be postponed at most 3 times and is then dropped.
Gifts are a small item table (herbal and industrial medicine, cloth, jade, gold, beer, survival meals). They are not taken from the guest's inventory.
Not built or checked for 1.6 or 1.5. No save/load roundtrip test for the new fields (DoorPolicy, PlannedGroup.Returning, GuestRecord.Shady, Returner and Gift).
tests: Run innI7 (final code, smoke plus all inn suites): RESULT PASS suites=17 checks=227 failures=0 newErrors=0. Run innI6 (same code except the last test-kit change): same result. Run innI5 (before the last two fixes): same result.
Runs innI3 and innI4 reproduced the stall at inn.night after 23:00; innI3 is the run with the autosave proof above.

Red errors left in the game log are not from Inn code: 'Could not find player faction' from Silverline.Patch_AddHediff.Postfix during world generation, and 'multiple Hearth.VenueTypeDefs named HH_Venue_Casino' (defined in both Venues_Types.xml and Casino_Research.xml). An earlier run also hit 'Tried to destroy already-destroyed thing Mote_Clean' inside VenueTestKit.Build; my suites no longer use that helper.
notes_for_integrator: Test runner (Hearth.Core/Testing/HearthTestRunner or tools/run_test.sh): switch autosave off for every module's test run, the same as InnTestKit.FastTime() (Prefs.AutosaveIntervalDays = 1000, plus DebugViewSettings.neverForceNormalSpeed = true). Any suite that runs past one game day can otherwise stall while its window is hidden; venues stalled this way in the m1 matrix. After that, InnTestKit.FastTime() can be removed.

Files changed outside my strict scope: Source/Hearth/Venues/VenueShopping.cs lost the old GuestFallback class (now in Venues/GuestFallback.cs, same namespace Hearth.ShopsFood, same public Enabled and Run). Source/Hearth/Venues/VenuesModule.cs line 99 still calls GuestFallback.Run(map) every 90 ticks. That is harmless because Run is idempotent per tick, but the Venues owner should delete the line. tools/inn/gen_keyed.py now filters out HH.Venue.* keys.

Venues: VenueTestKit.Build destroys things from a copied list without a !t.Destroyed check (error 'Tried to destroy already-destroyed thing Mote_Clean'); add the check. Also, JobDriver_WaitAtVenue could call Hearth.Guests.GuestThoughts.Waited(pawn, bell, nobodyCame) directly instead of relying on the satisfaction-reason text bridge.
Defs: HH_Venue_Casino is defined twice (Venues_Types.xml and Casino_Research.xml); remove one.

Silverline: Patch_AddHediff.Postfix calls Faction.OfPlayer during world generation and logs 'Could not find player faction' 13 to 25 times per run; it needs an early-out when there is no player faction yet.

Hospitality importer: TryMarkInnComp looks for the type Hearth.Guests.CompGuestBed, which does not exist (the Inn's comp is CompHH_GuestBed). The GuestBedImported event already covers this, so the reflection guess can go. TryConvertToGuestWing adds the wing to map.areaManager.AllAreas; the Inn moves it into its own wing list within 250 ticks, but adding it to GuestWings.Comp(map).wings directly would be cleaner.

Consumers can now use GuestApi.Renown(map) and Whispers(map) instead of their fixed values: Finance (the lottery demand formula uses a fixed 50), City (bodyguards can use GuestInfo.Vip) and UI (RenownLine is set by the Inn only when nobody else set it).
Not done yet from the requests: DesignationCategoryDef HH_Hospitality still lives only in the Venues patch; HH_FrontDesk still uses designationCategory Furniture.
